E1.evidence: Maintainer christophfroehlich posts the compiler output: "test_forward_command_controller.cpp:58:40: warning: ‘controller_interface::return_type controller_interface::ControllerInterfaceBase::init(const std::string&, const std::string&, unsigned int, const std::string&, const rclcpp::NodeOptions&)’ is deprecated: Use the init(const controller_interface::ControllerInterfaceParams & params) method instead. This method will be removed in the future ROS 2 releases. [-Wdeprecated-declarations]" (https://github.com/ros-controls/ros2_controllers/issues/1946).

E2.evidence: controller_interface (ros2_control repository) and forward_command_controller (ros2_controllers repository) are separately released packages. ros2_control#2390 marked the five-argument ControllerInterfaceBase::init `[[deprecated(...)]]` and added `init(const controller_interface::ControllerInterfaceParams & params)`; forward_command_controller's test still calls `controller_->init("forward_command_controller", "", 0, "", node_options)`. The provider's declared interface changed; not wiring, build-system, or firmware.

E3.evidence: UPGRADE: the consumer code references the provider's init overload as declared before ros2_control#2390 while it is compiled against a provider revision in which that overload is deprecated.

E4.evidence: Observed compiler warnings: "We see lots of deprecation warnings like" followed by the -Wdeprecated-declarations output (https://github.com/ros-controls/ros2_controllers/issues/1946).

units.name: controller_interface
units.revision_basis: The issue (2025-10-03T07:51Z) shows a rolling source workspace (/workspaces/ros2_rolling_ws/src/ros2_controllers/...) but no ros2_control revision. The deprecation entered ros2_control master with #2390 (merge 150641294b26e1b8bc98359bb281226d2cdaf226, 2025-10-02); the master head at the time of the report was ed23c135 (merge of #2611, 2025-10-03T07:20Z, the migration note the issue points to), which contains #2390; it is used as the broken revision. The resolution changes only the consumer, so the provider keeps ed23c135.

units.name: forward_command_controller
units.revision_basis: Broken: ros2_controllers master head at the time of the report (4b1f45ee, 2025-10-02, version bump 5.8.0); its forward_command_controller/test/test_forward_command_controller.cpp line 58 is `const auto result = controller_->init("forward_command_controller", "", 0, "", node_options);`, matching the quoted warning location 58:40. Resolved: merge commit of ros2_controllers#1973 on master (2025-11-07), where the test builds a ControllerInterfaceParams and calls `controller_->init(params)`; jazzy backport #2068 = a9e36acf5a7de85a2450f75018138249de7632ee.

resolution.summary: Consumer tests construct a controller_interface::ControllerInterfaceParams (controller_name, robot_description, update_rate, node_namespace, node_options) and call init(params) instead of the deprecated five-argument init (ros2_controllers#1973 on master; #2068 and #2181 for jazzy branches).
resolution.evidence: #1973 was merged after review with the contributor stating "I have done all the tests and fixed the issues." and a Codecov report; no build output of forward_command_controller at fcf89fc6 against an identified ros2_control revision is shown.

notes: Other compositions with the same deprecated call, fixed by the same PR, are not conditions of this case: ackermann_steering_controller, admittance_controller, bicycle_steering_controller, chained_filter_controller, diff_drive_controller, effort_controllers, force_torque_sensor_broadcaster, gpio_controllers, gps_sensor_broadcaster, imu_sensor_broadcaster, joint_state_broadcaster, joint_trajectory_controller, mecanum_drive_controller, motion_primitives_controllers, omni_wheel_drive_controller, parallel_gripper_controller, pid_controller, pose_broadcaster, position_controllers, range_sensor_broadcaster, steering_controllers_library, tricycle_controller, tricycle_steering_controller, velocity_controllers (and forward_command_controller's multi-interface test). The issue's quoted warning is for forward_command_controller, so that composition is specified. The only call site of the deprecated init in forward_command_controller is test code built with the package. consumer_built_against.broken is the parent of the #2390 merge (aebc2b88), the last ros2_control revision whose init declaration the consumer's call matches without deprecation; between aebc2b88 and ed23c135 the provider repository also merged #2476 (HardwareStatus publisher), #2452 (non-realtime controller switching) and #2611 (migration note), which are visible to checkers under this inferred basis. consumer_built_against.resolved is set to the provider revision in the composition because the resolved consumer calls the ControllerInterfaceParams overload present from 15064129 onward. Class element_retyped: the declaration gained a [[deprecated]] attribute while the element remains present. Issue text says "See https://github.com/ros-controls/ros2_control/pull/2611 how to fix them."
